channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Lula assume compromisso contra o trabalho escravo; Flávio fica de fora
item.description: Lula (PT) signed the Commitment Letter against Slave Labor, prioritizing the fight against this crime and human trafficking in his mandate. Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) was invited, but did not respond to the appeal.

item.title: 183 cartunistas fazem pôster conjunto em apoio a Lula
item.description: 183 cartoonists created a joint artwork supporting Lula, the re-election candidate, featuring campaign elements like the 'L' hand gesture and the number 13. The initiative underscores strong artistic backing for Lula as he faces Flávio Bolsonaro in the 2026 elections.

item.title: Leandra, ex de Janones, fala após debate da Globo: "Não é sobre vingança
item.description: Leandra Guedes, mayor of Ituiutaha and ex-wife of André Janones, participated in the Globo presidential debate invited by Flávio Bolsonaro, stating her presence was not motivated by revenge but by defending silenced women. Janones, an ally of Lula, could not attend the event due to a protective measure granted to Leandra in 2025 following allegations of threats to release intimate content.

item.title: ‘Não me interessa o que pensa Trump’, diz Celso Amorim a VEJA
item.description: Celso Amorim told VEJA he does not care about Trump's opinion on the Brazilian elections, focusing on domestic support for Lula's government while warning about the influence of Big Techs on politics. He emphasized the importance of national interests prevailing over foreign pressures, particularly digital algorithms that allegedly favored Flávio Bolsonaro.

item.title: Sistema eleitoral está blindado contra ingerência indevida, diz Kassio
item.description: The president of the TSE, Minister Kassio Nunes Marques, stated that the Brazilian electoral system is protected against any undue interference following an audit of the voting machine integrity. The verification confirmed the authenticity of the systems used in the second round of the 2026 elections and the issuance of the zeroth record. The minister emphasized the importance of transparency and the preservation of the electronic vote.

item.title: 6 pesquisas mostram disputa apertada entre Flávio e Lula neste sábado
item.description: Six polls released this week show an extremely tight race between Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) and President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) for the second round of the 2026 presidential elections. In five of the polls, Flávio is ahead, though within the margin of error, suggesting a technical tie. Only one poll, by Vox Brasil, shows Lula leading. The second round will take place this Sunday, October 25, 2026.

item.title: Hailey Bieber manifesta apoio a Lula
item.description: Hailey Bieber, an American influencer of Brazilian mother, expressed support for Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva in a post on her Instagram, resharing content by photographer Rafael Pavarotti highlighting democratic values, indigenous rights, the Amazon, education, science, and culture. The post was published the day before the 2026 presidential runoff, in which Lula runs for reelection against Flávio Bolsonaro.

item.title: TSE deve regular meios de comunicação para evitar “ringue”, diz Toffoli
item.description: TSE Minister Dias Toffoli advocated for regulating communication media to prevent electoral campaigns from turning into a 'brawl', criticizing the use of public time for candidate offenses. He emphasized the need to return to discussing public policies instead of personal confrontations.

item.title: Flávio gasta 6 vezes o valor de Lula em anúncios na última semana de campanha
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) spent R$6.79 million on Meta ads in the final week of campaigning, 6.2 times more than Lula (PT), who invested R$1.09 million. Flávio's ads focused on public security and Tarcísio de Freitas' image, accounting for 49.3% of total spending on the page. BBC News Brasil collected the data from Meta's Ad Library, which differs from TSE information.

item.title: Queda de guindaste na Linha 15 prejudica ida de apoiadores a ato pró-Lula
item.description: An accident between a Linha 15-Prata train and a crane on Avenida Professor Luiz Ignácio de Anhaia Mello disrupted the movement of protesters heading to a pro-Lula rally on Avenida Paulista in São Paulo. With buses unavailable and ride-hailing prices high, some supporters chose to walk to the event.

item.title: Saiba os direitos de idosos e pessoas com deficiência para votar
item.description: Brazilian legislation ensures accessibility rights and priority service for elderly citizens and people with disabilities or reduced mobility during elections. These measures include adapted infrastructure, accessibility coordinators, reserved parking spaces, and section transfers to better accommodate voters.

item.title: A boa notícia das pesquisas internas de Lula na véspera da eleição
item.description: Internal qualitative surveys from Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva's 2026 campaign suggest a favorable outlook for the PT candidate in the final stretch, boosting morale among supporters. The data, not yet made public, was published exclusively for subscribers of a specific news outlet. This development has served as an emotional boost for the Petitioner base before the vote.

item.title: Lula e Flávio concordam em mínimo acima da inflação e em mais 6 temas
item.description: Lula and Flávio agreed on seven economic issues during the TV Globo debate, including Bolsa Família, railways, small businesses, debt renegotiation, minimum wage, weekend free fares, and veto on privatizations. Flávio preserved social programs and strategic state companies, while Lula pushed for expanded weekend public transport fare exemptions.

item.title: Presidente do TSE defende urnas a observadores internacionais: "Super Bowl"
item.description: TSE president Kassio Nunes Marques defended the security and transparency of Brazil's electronic voting system by comparing the electoral operation to the Super Bowl, during a meeting with international observers covering the presidential runoff.

item.title: Mãe de Ana Clara participa de ato de Lula em Copacabana após embate com Flávio Bolsonaro em debate
item.description: The mother of Ana Clara, a girl killed by police gunfire in Niterói, attended Lula's rally in Copacabana after clashing with Flávio Bolsonaro in the Globo debate. Lula used the case to question Flávio's defense of the accused officer at the STJ. Her presence was orchestrated by the PT campaign to emphasize security and justice in the final stretch.

item.title: Toffoli defende que TSE edite regras para que propagandas e debates não sejam 'ringues' e 'voltem' a discutir política
item.description: Minister Dias Toffoli advocated for the TSE to establish rules preventing political advertisements and debates from becoming 'duels', emphasizing policy proposals over personal attacks between candidates.

item.title: “Quem ganha em Minas ganha no Brasil”, diz Flávio ao lado de Cleitinho
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) stated that winning Minas Gerais and São Paulo signals presidential victory. He participated in a motorcycle rally in Belo Horizonte alongside Cleitinho Azevedo (Republicanos), the newly elected governor of Minas.

item.title: PGR pede ao STF para suspender decisão de Nunes Marques que restringe transporte de indígenas no segundo turno
item.description: The Brazilian Attorney General's Office requested the Supreme Court to suspend a decision by the TSE president, Nunes Marques, requiring prior authorization for transporting Indigenous voters in the second round. The PGR argues this rule may prevent 7,200 Indigenous voters, many dependent on river transport, from voting, and asks to reinstate a previously approved federal plan. Nunes Marques' order requires detailed identification of vehicles, routes, and schedules.

item.title: PGR pede que STF derrube exigência de autorização prévia para transporte de indígenas no 2º turno
item.description: Attorney General Paulo Gonet requested the Supreme Federal Court to overturn the requirement for prior authorization to transport indigenous people during the second round of the 2026 elections. The TSE determination mandated authorization for indigenous transportation during the electoral process.

item.title: Lula discursa no Rio e Flávio evita falar em BH: entenda o que a lei permite na véspera da eleição
item.description: On the eve of the runoff, Lula gave speeches during a walk in Copacabana, while Flávio Bolsonaro avoided a formal address in the BH motorcycle rally to prevent it from being classified as a prohibited rally. The distinction lies in the event format, not a ban on vote requests.

item.title: Ao vivo: Lula realiza ato na av. Paulista
item.description: President Lula concludes his campaign with a walk on Paulista Avenue in São Paulo at 4 PM, following a morning rally in Copacabana, Rio. The event features allies such as Geraldo Alckmin, Fernando Haddad, Marina Silva, and Simone Tebet, amid heightened political activity before Sunday's vote.

item.title: Matteo Bocelli entrega suas preferências no Brasil
item.description: Matteo Bocelli, son of Italian tenor Andrea Bocelli, acknowledges that part of the audience watches him due to his surname and not just his talent, in statements to VEJA magazine. At 29 years old, he is seeking to build his own artistic identity and is preparing for a tour through Brazil, visiting eight cities with his band, with a show in São Paulo on Saturday, October 24, 2026.

item.title: Ana Clara e erro de Lula lideram menções sobre debate, diz Bites
item.description: The debate between Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro generated 1.5 million mentions on social media, with emphasis on the death of Ana Clara (257k) and Lula's misstatement about 'ending the police' (194k). Flávio leads in positive sentiment, but Lula has higher digital engagement.

item.title: Com volume recorde de processos, TSE terá de julgar ações que vão desde acusação de favorecimento de plataformas a 'rede de desinformação'
item.description: The 2026 elections set a record with 1,476 legal cases at the TSE, including allegations of disinformation and platform bias. Flávio Bolsonaro leads with 624 cases, followed by Lula with 473. The court prioritizes urgent matters during the vote but may rule on ineligibility cases afterward.

item.title: Lula volta à Paulista no último dia de campanha; aposta em atos de rua marcou segundo turno
item.description: Lula takes part in a walk on Paulista Avenue on the last day of campaign before the second round, with a large mobilization of supporters and allies such as Alckmin and Haddad. The gathering brought together anti-fascist demonstrations, fan clubs and sympathizers who criticize Flávio Bolsonaro, highlighting the PT's strategy of street protests after the first round.

item.title: Número do telefone de Lula vaza em live de Janones
item.description: During a live stream with federal congressman André Janones, President Lula had his phone number accidentally leaked. The incident sparked social media commentary but did not significantly impact the tone of their interaction.

item.title: Janones vaza número de Lula durante live de 24 horas
item.description: Federal deputy André Janones (Rede-MG) leaked a phone number attributed to President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) during a live broadcast before receiving a call from the PT leader. The incident occurred during the 24-hour 'Live da Virada' broadcast that started Friday night (October 23) and runs through Saturday. Lula joined the live stream after receiving a phone from the governor of Piauí, Rafael Fonteles (PT), to participate in the WhatsApp group 'Exército do Lula'.

item.title: Assessora sinaliza permanência de secretária da Cultura de Tarcísio no segundo mandato
item.description: Marília Marton, São Paulo's state Culture Secretary, indicated via a message sent from her official phone the possibility of remaining in office during Tarcísio de Freitas's (Republicanos) second term. The information was released on October 24, 2026.

item.title: Lula faz ato em Copacabana, e Flávio vai à motociata em BH; acompanhe o último dia de campanha
item.description: Lula and Flávio wrap up campaign with rallies in Copacabana and Belo Horizonte, exchanging attacks and drawing large crowds. Lula expressed confidence in a late surge and criticized his opponent’s low level. Both head to additional capitals as the runoff contest intensifies.

item.title: Ato pró-Lula volta a reunir centenas de brasileiros no Portão de Brandemburgo em Berlim
item.description: Hundreds of Brazilians gathered at the Brandenburg Gate in Berlin to support Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva's re-election, marking the second consecutive weekend of protests. Despite rain and cold, supporters held the rally at the iconic landmark, showing backing for the PT candidate. The meeting is part of a series of international events supporting Lula's re-election.

item.title: Eleições 2026: saiba o horário de votação em cada estado
item.description: The second round of the 2026 elections will take place on October 25th, with voting from 8am to 5pm (Brasília time), varying by local timezone. Voters must bring an official ID with photo, and results begin to be released after polls close.

item.title: Eurasia aponta recuperação de Lula, mas vê pouco tempo para virada
item.description: The Eurasia Group reduced Flávio Bolsonaro's chances of winning from 70% to 60%, but still considers the PL candidate the favorite. Despite Lula's recovery in polls, the consultancy warns that insufficient time remains for a turnaround. The intensified PT campaign and reduced scandal discussion contributed to improving the president's image.

item.title: Apoiadores de Lula e Flávio Bolsonaro fazem últimos atos de campanha em Apucarana
item.description: Supporters of Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro held their final campaign rallies in Apucarana, reinforcing positions ahead of the runoff. The events gathered sympathizers from both sides for closing speeches before the election.

item.title: Esquerda mobiliza hashtag em apoio a Lula após Flávio chamá-lo de nove dedos em debate
item.description: After Flávio Bolsonaro called Lula 'nine fingers' during a debate, the left-wing mobilized the hashtag #SomosTodosNoveDedos in support of the president, posting criticisms of the opponent's statement on social media.

item.title: CNT/MDA: Flávio tem 50,7% dos votos válidos e Lula, 49,3%; mulheres são maioria entre indecisos
item.description: The CNT/MDA poll shows Flávio Bolsonaro leading with 50.7% and Lula with 49.3% in the second round, within technical tie. Women account for 4% of undecided voters, compared to 1% of men.

item.title: Manifestantes se reúnem em ato em apoio a Flávio Bolsonaro em BH
item.description: Supporters of Flávio Bolsonaro held a rally at Praça da Liberdade in Belo Horizonte during the final rally before the presidential runoff. The event gathered protesters supporting the Rio senator's campaign for president.

item.title: Mesmo com desculpas de Flávio, PL mantém nas redes fala sobre nove dedos
item.description: The PL party reposted on social media a joke by Flávio Bolsonaro about Lula's physical disability, despite the senator apologizing to the president during the TV Globo debate. The move sparked criticism for maintaining an offensive discourse despite the conciliatory gesture. The episode highlights polarization and the use of controversial humor in the 2026 election campaign.

item.title: Médico do Einstein diz ter recursos para não atender 'petista vagabundo'
item.description: Dr. Clederson Henry Dina from the Albert Einstein Hospital faced backlash after making derogatory remarks against supporters of President Lula, including stating he has "resources" to not treat "vagabond PT supporters". The comments sparked controversy on social media.

item.title: MPE pede anulação da candidatura de Canella por ligação com milícias
item.description: The MPE requested the TSE to annul Márcio Canella's candidacy (União Brasil) due to alleged ties with militias and the Comando Vermelho. The filed opinion states there are indications of the politician's involvement with criminal organizations. TSE's decision on the case is still pending.

item.title: PT diz que Metrô recuou sobre instalação de tapumes no entorno de estações
item.description: The São Paulo Metro retracted permission for campaign-installed barriers around Trianon-Masp and Consolação stations, requesting their removal overnight on Saturday, October 24, before Lula's final campaign rally on Paulista Avenue. Lula's campaign had coordinated the barriers with the company to protect public infrastructure from vandalism. The incident follows the Metro filing a police report for damage to stations after a previous rally.

item.title: Em BH, Flávio se abraça em deputada que recebia mesada na Farra do INSS
item.description: In Belo Horizonte, Senator Flávio Bolsonaro was photographed embracing state deputy Chiara Biondini, who is under investigation for receiving R$ 60,000 from Conafer in an INSS fraud scheme. The deputy, daughter of federal deputy Eros Biondini, was allegedly used to pressure her father politically. The image sparked backlash for linking Flávio to figures involved in corruption schemes.

item.title: Elecciones en Brasil, en vivo | Bolsonaro y Lula apuran la campaña con dos actos en dos ciudades cada uno
item.description: The 2026 Brazilian presidential race is tied between Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro, with heated debates on security and economy. The outcome will resonate across Latin America, influencing the region's rightward shift.

item.title: Colunistas do Metrópoles analisam quem venceu debate da Globo; veja notas
item.description: Metrópoles columnists assessed the TV Globo debate between Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro, giving each candidate a score of 5. The debate highlighted economic proposals, with criticisms of policy copying and discussions on public debt and food prices.

item.title: Lula convoca “exército” para buscar quem não votou no 1º turno
item.description: Lula rallied supporters in Copacabana to encourage non-voters from the first round to head to the polls in the runoff. He emphasized voting as essential to strengthening Brazilian democracy and criticized Flávio Bolsonaro’s proposals, such as SUS privatization. The event featured allied politicians and public figures from Rio de Janeiro.

item.title: Pneu de carro fura em ato no Rio, e Lula aproveita contratempo para alfinetar Flávio: 'Ele diria que iria voando'
item.description: While campaigning in Rio de Janeiro, President Lula had a tire blowout on his pickup truck and used the setback to mock rival Flávio Bolsonaro, claiming he would have lied about it. Lula emphasized the importance of voting to strengthen democracy and referenced the case of 5-year-old Ana Clara, killed by a police bullet.

item.title: Lula diz estar confiante de que vencerá eleição porque 'brasileiros não podem levar um miliciano para o Palácio do Planalto'
item.description: President Lula expressed confidence in winning the election, arguing that Brazilians should not elect a militia member to the Presidential Palace. He emphasized the threat to democracy, freedom, and the well-being of society. Lula predicted his re-election in the runoff.

item.title: Lula chama Flávio de ‘candidato de baixo nível’ e volta a rebater ataque capacitista
item.description: Lula called Flávio 'the lowest-level candidate' and linked him to militias during a campaign rally in Rio. Recalling the Globo debate, the president accused his rival of dishonesty and highlighted the legal dispute over the Ilha Comprida land involving Richarlison, allegedly favored by SPU processing granted to his ally Willer Tomaz.

item.title: Florianópolis, Goiânia, Aracaju: atos de Lula e Flávio mobilizam apoiadores pelo país; veja vídeos
item.description: Lula and Flávio mobilize supporters in simultaneous acts across multiple cities the day before the second round. Events take place in Florianópolis, Goiânia, Aracaju, Maceió and Fortaleza, with videos going viral on social media.

item.title: Menção ao caso Ana Clara e atuação de Flávio Bolsonaro: ONU analisa denúncia sobre milícias no Rio em dezembro
item.description: The UN will review a complaint in December regarding the expansion of militias in Rio de Janeiro, including the case of the girl Ana Clara. The complaint alleges suspected connections between criminal groups and public officials, citing figures such as Flávio Bolsonaro, Jair Bolsonaro, and Cláudio Castro.

item.title: Ao vivo: Flávio realiza ato na Barra da Tijuca
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) holds a campaign rally in Barra da Tijuca, Rio de Janeiro, starting at 2 PM on Saturday (Oct 24, 2026), after spending time in Belo Horizonte. Rio de Janeiro, Minas Gerais, and São Paulo are strategic states in the final stretch of the campaign, home to the largest number of voters in the country. In Minas Gerais, historically, 95% of presidents elected since 1945 have won there, highlighting its decisive role.
